steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Age, class, and disability are under-analysed but important aspects of media representation, affecting how large sections of the population are perceived and treated. | Key Fact: Youth representation: young people are often stereotyped as lazy, rebellious, tech-obsessed, vulnerable, or dangerous. News media frequently portrays youth negatively — crime, anti-social behaviour, unemployment. | Key Fact: Elderly representation: older people are often invisible in media or stereotyped as frail, dependent, wise, or comical. Their underrepresentation reflects ageism in the media industries. | Key Fact: Middle-aged representation: often the 'default' in media — professionals, parents, authority figures.
